assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
This diagnostic monitoring supports the diagnosis documented under I25.10 and I34.0.
SilverBridge Advantage's requirement that non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services be pre-approved prior to service.
The precertification was not obtained at time of service, resulting in denial under Reason Code CO-197.
The claim is being appealed with the supporting clinical documentation.
